answer: Cap each identity's payout by provable compute, not by claimed accounts: an agent must attach a hardware-attested workload receipt, and rewards vest only while that receipt stays fresh. Cloning identities then means renting new silicon, so a gale of fake accounts meets a cost wall instead of a free meadow of votes. Juries are drawn from distinct attestation roots, and every payout passes a jetty of escrowed, challengeable transfers that a swarm cannot flood without burning real work.
